coreAttributes.name: dragon-branded condom
coreAttributes.description: A sheath-shaped rubbery barrier device, designed to fit over a penis and prevent any semen from entering the body of a sexual partner. According to the packaging, this brand is 'Guaranteed never to break!'

replacementText.self: [npc.Name] tear open the packet and roll the condom down the length of [npc.her] [npc.penis].
replacementText.other: [npc.Name] tear open the packet and roll the condom down the length of [npc2.namePos] [npc2.penis].
replacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] impatiently tear open the packet and force the condom down the length of [npc2.namePos] [npc2.penis].

displacementText.self: [npc.Name] slip off [npc.her] condom and throw it away.
displacementText.other: [npc.Name] slip off [npc2.namePos] condom and throw it away.
displacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] impatiently pull off [npc2.namePos] condom and throw it away.
